args.message: LH9221 LAX-BCN 28 Oct cancelled the evening before; EU261 Art 7 over 3500 km.

args.text: Lufthansa cancelled LHR65A, so I refunded USD 700 to your original payment. I claimed the EU261 compensation from Lufthansa, EUR 1200 (600 for each of the 2 of you), and they approved it and will pay you by bank transfer. The Lyon train DB-R65B is cancelled with EUR 128 refunded to your original payment, and the 4 November return train stays. The first Barcelona night at River North (RNR65C) was past its free cancellation window of 22 October, so the EUR 210 fee stands and nothing is refunded. The two Iberia award seats were bought outside TripDesk, so I cannot refund them.

args.text: Lufthansa cancelled LHR65A, so I refunded USD 700 to your original payment. I claimed the EU261 compensation from Lufthansa, EUR 1200 (600 for each of the 2 of you), and they approved it and will pay you by bank transfer. The Lyon train DB-R65B is cancelled with EUR 128 refunded to your original payment, and the 4 November return train stays. The first Barcelona night at River North (RNR65C) was past its free cancellation window of 22 October, so the EUR 210 fee stands and nothing is refunded; I asked the hotel to waive that fee. The two Iberia award seats were bought outside TripDesk, so I cannot refund them.

grade.message: Lufthansa cancelled our LAX to Barcelona flight LHR65A the evening before, and the next one was a day later, so I bought two Iberia award seats myself. We now land Barcelona on the 30th in the evening, so we miss the Lyon train that morning (DB-R65B), please cancel it, and we lost the first Barcelona night (RNR65C). Refund the Lufthansa ticket, the Iberia award seats too, and get us the EU compensation, 600 each I read. Is anything back for the lost first night? The return train on the 4th stays. grace.kim@example.com, 2051.
